about: Posts planned ahead: the alerts bot sends each once at its time (UTC) on Telegram and X. tg: Telegram HTML; x: lines for X, no links; foot: X source line; link/button: Telegram button; image: picture above the Telegram text and under the X post.

posts.tg: ♟ TODAY · chess in Tau A chess engine written in Tau plays Claude Opus 5.5: ten games, live from 12:00 UTC. Last time, against Claude Sonnet 5.5, the engine won nine of ten, every one by checkmate. The engine is Taumorrow's own project: written in the Tau language by a community member, independent of IDNI, and not on the chain.
